topic: 旅行经历与基础测评 · Independent new scenario: organising a weekend trip with constraints
grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Weekend Trip Planning with Constraints
instructions: 本材料为模拟教学练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听/读对话，注意说话人如何商量周末旅行、遇到限制条件时如何调整计划。然后完成8道听力/阅读题。接着学习一般过去时（规则与常用不规则动词）以及 then / after that / finally 的用法，并完成8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目答案均可在原文中找到依据。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo. Do you want to go to the beach this weekend?
Leo: I do, but my car is broken. We can't drive there.
Mia: OK. We can take the train. The train leaves at eight.
Leo: Eight is early. I work late on Friday. Can we go at ten?
Mia: Yes, the ten o'clock train is fine. We arrived at the beach at eleven last time. The train ride takes about one hour.
Leo: Good. But I have only fifty dollars. The train ticket is fifteen dollars.
Mia: That's OK. I have thirty dollars. We can buy sandwiches and water. Together we have enough money for the tickets and food.
Leo: Perfect. After that, we can walk on the beach. Then we can swim.
Mia: Wait, I can't swim. I forgot my swimsuit.
Leo: No problem. We can play volleyball instead. It is fun and easy. Finally, we can take the six o'clock train home.
Mia: Great. I called my sister yesterday. She wants to come too.
Leo: Nice. She can meet us at the station at nine thirty.
Mia: OK. See you on Saturday!

grammar.title: 一般过去时：规则与常用不规则动词；then / after that / finally
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词在动词后加 -ed，例如 walk → walked, play → played。以 e 结尾的动词直接加 -d，例如 arrive → arrived。常用不规则动词需要单独记，例如 go → went, have → had, buy → bought, take → took, forget → forgot, swim → swam, meet → met, leave → left, call → called（规则）。否定句用 didn't + 动词原形，例如 I didn't go. 一般疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形？例如 Did you swim? 另外，then / after that / finally 用来按顺序连接过去的动作：then 表示“然后”，after that 表示“在那之后”，finally 表示“最后”。
grammar.example: I called my sister yesterday. She wants to come too.

questions.prompt: Yesterday I ___ to the park with my friend.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，go 的不规则过去式是 went。

questions.prompt: She ___ a new book last week.
questions.explanation: last week 表示过去，buy 的不规则过去式是 bought。

questions.prompt: We ___ at the hotel at nine o'clock.
questions.explanation: 句子描述过去，arrive 是规则动词，过去式加 -d 变成 arrived。
this morning 表示过去，forget 的不规则过去式是 forgot。
过去时的一般疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形，所以是 Did you play。
questions.evidence: Did + 主语 + 动词原形

questions.prompt: I ___ swim last year. I was afraid of water.
questions.explanation: last year 表示过去，否定用 didn't + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: First we had lunch. ___, we walked on the beach.
questions.explanation: then 表示“然后”，用来连接先后发生的动作。

questions.prompt: We took the train. After that, we ___ home.
questions.explanation: after that 表示过去动作的顺序，walk 是规则动词，过去式是 walked。
